BIM Dev · A-103

Dynamo — Room Name Standardisation

Stack: Dynamo / Python / Excel — Revit room naming
  • Built a Dynamo graph that reads a two-column Excel mapping list (IFC room name → project use name) to correct Revit room names in bulk instead of editing rooms one by one
  • Imports the list with Data.ImportExcel, then passes the rooms picked with Select Model Elements, a Boolean switch, and the mapping list into a Python Script node, with Watch nodes to check the input and the output names
  • Result: consistent room names (for example A-DATA HALL-1A → A-DH-1S1A) carried onto the room tags, alongside FFL level and ceiling height
